jellicent-standard.label: Taunt wall
jellicent-standard.description: Burns attackers with Will-O-Wisp, Taunts walls and setup, and heals with Recover.

heatran-sunny-day-trapper.label: Sun trapper
heatran-sunny-day-trapper.description: Traps foes with Magma Storm and fires sun-boosted Solar Beams at the Water-types that come in.

metagross-shuca-berry-attacker.label: Bulky attacker
metagross-shuca-berry-attacker.description: Survives a Ground-type hit with Shuca Berry and hits back with Meteor Mash and priority Bullet Punch.

mew-defensive.label: Will-O-Wisp support
mew-defensive.description: Burns attackers with Will-O-Wisp, Taunts setup, and heals with Soft-Boiled.

sableye-prankster.label: Prankster support
sableye-prankster.description: Uses Will-O-Wisp, Taunt, and Recover before the foe can move, thanks to Prankster.

crobat-stallbreaker.description: Uses Taunt to stop defensive Pokémon from healing or setting hazards, and pivots out with U-turn.

azumarill-bulky-attacker.label: Bulky attacker
azumarill-bulky-attacker.description: Huge Power makes every hit count; a bulky spread and Sitrus Berry let it take hits, and Aqua Jet picks off weakened foes.

snorlax-offensive.label: Pursuit trapper
snorlax-offensive.description: Hits hard off its huge HP and catches fleeing Psychic- and Ghost-types with Pursuit.

chansey-cleric.label: Cleric
chansey-cleric.description: Cures the team with Aromatherapy, paralyzes with Thunder Wave, and takes special hits with Eviolite.

celebi-bulky-pivot.label: Baton Pass support
celebi-bulky-pivot.description: Makes a Substitute and passes it to a teammate with Baton Pass, healing with Recover.

magnezone-sunny-day.label: Steel trapper
magnezone-sunny-day.description: Traps Steel-types with Magnet Pull and burns them with sun-boosted Hidden Power Fire.

kingdra-rain-dance.label: Rain Dance attacker
kingdra-rain-dance.description: Sets its own rain with Rain Dance to power up its Water attacks, with Draco Meteor for coverage.

tyranitar-bulky-pursuit-trapper.label: Pursuit trapper
tyranitar-bulky-pursuit-trapper.description: Traps and removes fleeing Psychic- and Ghost-types with Pursuit, while its bulk soaks special hits.

tornadus-rain-dance.label: Rain Dance support
tornadus-rain-dance.description: Sets rain with a Prankster Rain Dance, then hits hard with Hurricane, which never misses in rain.

tornadus-mixed-attacker.label: Rain Dance attacker
tornadus-mixed-attacker.description: Sets rain with a Prankster Rain Dance, then breaks through with Hurricane, Grass Knot, and Superpower.

blissey-special-wall.label: Special wall
blissey-special-wall.description: Absorbs special attacks, heals with Soft-Boiled, and sets Stealth Rock.

blissey-toxic-attacker.label: Toxic staller
blissey-toxic-attacker.description: Absorbs special attacks and wears foes down with Toxic, Flamethrower, and Ice Beam.

politoed-defensive.label: Rain setter
politoed-defensive.description: Brings rain with Drizzle that lasts until another weather replaces it, and walls physical attackers with Scald, Protect, and Encore.

azelf-dual-screens.label: Dual screens lead
azelf-dual-screens.description: Taunts the foe's lead, sets Stealth Rock, and puts up Reflect and Light Screen for the team.

azelf-all-out-attacker.label: Stealth Rock attacker
azelf-all-out-attacker.description: Sets Stealth Rock, then hits hard with Life Orb-boosted attacks.

arcanine-sunny-day.label: Sun attacker
arcanine-sunny-day.description: Sets sun with Sunny Day to power up Fire Blast and fire Solar Beam without charging.

cofagrigus-offensive-trick-room.label: Trick Room attacker
cofagrigus-offensive-trick-room.description: Sets Trick Room so it moves first, then boosts with Nasty Plot and sweeps.

venusaur-leech-seed.label: Leech Seed staller
venusaur-leech-seed.description: Hides behind Substitute and Protect while Leech Seed drains the foe.

abomasnow-subseed.label: Leech Seed staller
abomasnow-subseed.description: Hides behind Substitute while Leech Seed drains the foe, with Ice Shard to finish it.

umbreon-wish-support.label: Wish support
umbreon-wish-support.description: Passes Wish heals to teammates, cures status with Heal Bell, and punishes physical attackers with Foul Play.
